conditions: Without Piloting 5 the Orokin Shield Derelict has no marker; some threads wrongly say rank 10.

groups.activity: Archwing into the Orokin Shield Derelict, hack the terminal, finish the mission
conditions: Hack the terminal before finishing the mission if you like; the reward only counts once the mission completes.
Point of Interest Cache A never drops Athodai; only the derelict's Cache B does.
Leaving before mission completion loses the roll, and there is no pity system for Railjack caches.
bonuses: Void Storms don't change the derelict odds, so open relics or roll Void Storm rewards in the same run.

disclosures.title: why Bifrost Echo
disclosures.body: It's the lowest-level Venus Proxima node (enemy level 15-18), so both the derelict detour and the mission finish fastest. Every Venus Proxima node shares the same Cache B table.
